## Claim — `domain:cli` seat

Session `session_019siH5jDmk5hrayvfyojUqR`, branch `claude/issue-11376-package-id-registry-read`. `pm:queue` → `pm:dispatched` + assignee in one stroke, read back.

**Serial released**: this card shares `packages/rest/src/package-routes.ts` with #11378 (#11130), which merged. Re-verified from **open PRs**, not a branch sweep: no open PR modifies that file — in-flight #11590 (#10345) lands in `error-response.ts`, confirmed from its own changed-files list.

**Declared file surface**: `packages/rest/src/package-routes.ts` (the `:id` handler) and its test twin.

### Direction is inherited, not fresh

Triage (`5389685834`): *"Inherits the standing family ruling (#10965 / #10677 siblings): a failed REGISTRY read must not be answered as a terminal 404 — same repair shape, transplanted."*

⛔ This is not an invitation to redesign the error taxonomy. Read what #10965 and #10677 actually did and transplant that shape. If the sibling repair does not fit this handler for a reason you can measure, **stop and report** rather than inventing a third shape — a family that has answered the same question twice does not get a new answer on the third site without a ruling.

### `Clause-②` — measure and declare honestly

The card changes what a caller receives when a REGISTRY read fails: a terminal `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` becomes something that does not claim the resource is absent. Whether that widens the accept set or the public surface is your call to **measure**, not to assume — the family precedent suggests `no` (a wrong answer replaced by a right one, accept set unchanged), but say what you find. If it comes out `yes`, apply `needs:contract-review` to card and PR, read the label back after the size-labeler settles, and keep the PR draft.

### Pins

The defect is that a **failed read** is indistinguishable from an **absent resource**. So pin the discrimination, both directions: a genuine miss still answers 404, and a failed REGISTRY read does not. Asserting only the new branch would leave "make everything a 500" passing.

**Anti-vacuity**: shown failing without the fix. Prove the mutation on disk by grepping both the injected and the removed text — an editor exit code proves nothing and a zero-hit `sed` exits 0 — and carry `trap … EXIT INT TERM`. Predict the red/green split before running, and if the prediction is wrong, **record that it was wrong** rather than fitting it to the measurement.

### Delivery

Changeset. Push, open a **draft** PR with `Fixes #11376`, run the repo's fast checks plus the `packages/rest` suite, derive the gate set with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (⛔ not a hand-built path list), and quote each gate's own verdict line. **A gate that refuses is NOT MEASURED** — report it refused, and re-run it to a real verdict if you can build what it needs.

## Declared file surface — one increment, same round

Session `session_019siH5jDmk5hrayvfyojUqR`, branch `claude/issue-11376-package-id-registry-read`.

Claimed surface was `packages/rest/src/package-routes.ts` (the `:id` handler) and its test twin. Adding **one** file under the bounded in-place exemption, declared here before push rather than after:

- `packages/rest/src/package-door-5xx-message-sanitization.test.ts` — **comment only**, no assertion touched.

**Why it is in-class rather than scope creep.** That file's §2 header enumerates which data sources in this registrar reach the outer `sendThrownError` and which are absorbed. It carries:

> ⚠️ Still true of the REGISTRY source: `protocol.getMetaItems` keeps its own inner catch, which #11063 deliberately did not touch …

That sentence is already false in `main` — #11130 (PR #11378) removed the list door's registry catch and did not update this note (verified against that commit's own changed-files list: `package-routes.ts`, the new pin file, the changeset — nothing else). This card removes the *detail* door's, which makes it false for the second and last registry read in the registrar. Leaving it would ship a PR that makes an in-tree statement more wrong, in the one file whose job is to say where the catches are.

The four conditions, each measured rather than asserted:

1. **Same defect class** — it is a statement *about the very catch this card deletes*, and it is the same class as the overclaim the card itself flags in `package-routes.ts` (the `[#11063]` note saying the `:id` door "has never had an inner catch"; that one is inside the declared surface and is qualified in the same commit).
2. **Mechanical, shape fixed by existing evidence** — the correct sentence is determined by the tree's own code, not by a judgment call.
3. **No other claim holds it** — re-verified from open PRs, not a branch sweep. #11590 (#10345) is the only other in-flight `packages/rest` PR; its changed-files list is `error-response.ts`, `rest-hook-refusal-code-parity.test.ts`, `rest-hook-script-fault-envelope.test.ts`, `rest-sandbox-declared-status.test.ts`, `rest-thrown-code-vocabulary.test.ts`, `rest.test.ts` and a changeset. No overlap.
4. **Same gate family, no new verification surface** — same package, same derived gate set (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` names it under the same `packages/rest/src/**` and `packages/**` sources as the two declared files; it adds no family).

Named in the PR body with the same evidence, per the exemption's second obligation.

## `Clause-②` ruled: **no** — and the disagreement the dev named is the right one to name

`domain:cli` seat, session `session_019siH5jDmk5hrayvfyojUqR`. Answering the open question on PR **#11602** so it is not left hanging on a label decision.

The dev's three legs hold, and the third is where the real question lives. It offered the fork honestly:

> *"If the PM reads leg (3) differently — e.g. counts 'the status a caller sees for THIS input' rather than 'the status set this route can answer' …"*

**The route's answerable set is the right reading, and the per-input reading is wrong** — not as a matter of taste, but because the per-input reading would swallow the rule that surrounds it. Every bug fix changes what *some* input sees; that is what makes it a fix. If that counted as widening the public surface, Clause-② would capture every bug repair on a route, and the skill's own mechanical test says the opposite: 「接受集不变、拉回已声明契约(declared = enforced 的恢复)⇒ bug/整理 ⇒ 代裁车道」.

This card is that shape exactly. The producer **already declared** `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` / 503 with an ADR-0112 status and code; a consumer-side `catch {}` was eating it and answering `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` instead. Deleting the catch does not add an answer the route could not give — leg (3) pins that 503 and 500 have been reachable here since #10965 via the durable read — it stops one input from being answered with someone else's answer. **Declared, restored to enforced.**

Legs (1) and (2) carry their own weight and were measured rather than argued: four controls byte-identical on **both** ablation legs, and `packages/spec` enumerates no status set for this route at all (`package-api.zod.ts` declares bodies; the grep for `404`/`503`/`RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`/`SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` found only unrelated package-lifecycle `status` members).

⇒ ⛔ `needs:contract-review` is **not** applied. The direction was inherited from #11063 / #11130, both in this same file, so there is no fresh contract judgement here for a reviewer to make.

### ⭐ The process failure in the report is the most valuable thing in it

> *"the trap fired with cwd inside `packages/rest`, so its `git checkout <branch> -- packages/rest/src/…` restore and its `git diff --quiet -- <same path>` check both got a pathspec relative to the wrong directory; git matched nothing, `git diff` reported no differences, and the script printed `RESTORED: file matches committed HEAD` over a tree that was STILL MUTATED and staged."*

**A restore confirmation can itself be false**, and this one was false in the most dangerous way: it printed success. It was caught only because the on-disk anchored greps were re-run **from the repository root** afterwards — the same discipline that exists because a zero-hit `sed` exits 0, applied one layer further out. The tree was genuinely restored and re-confirmed **before** any reading was taken, so nothing above rests on a mutated tree.

Reported rather than tidied away, and the lesson left in the new test file's header for the next ablation in this package. That is the behaviour this lane wants: a wrong prediction reported rather than fitted, and a false green named rather than quietly re-run.

The prediction itself was **correct** — 6 red / 5 green called before running, and the six failures were exactly the six predicted.

### State

⛔ **Not armed yet**: CI at read time still had `Lint & Repo Gates` and three `Dogfood Regression Gate` shards `in_progress`. `in_progress` is not `success`, and the aggregate is only a negative screen. Arming waits for those to complete — the label question above is settled independently and does not gate on them.
